name: Grand Chancellor Vess Adorth
description: A poised and calculating Tiefling dressed in gilded robes, Vess' emerald eyes reflect shifting schemes. Their coiled tail betrays emotion, and their monocle glows with magical auras.
notes: Has access to Master of Intrigue and Master of Tactics features. Can use the Help action as a bonus action. Commands a network of spies and can forge any document flawlessly.

name: General Maekros Dorn
description: A towering Goliath in scarred crimson armor, Dorn's body is inked with tactical oaths and past victories. His calm voice and steel gaze command loyalty.
notes: Has 3 maneuvers: Commander’s Strike, Menacing Attack, and Rally. Can use Second Wind, Action Surge (2x), and Indomitable (2x). Inspires troops in mass combat.

name: The Raven 'Liora Velthrenn'
description: Shrouded in black-violet robes and veiled behind a rune-inscribed mask, Liora exudes unnatural calm. Her silver hair drifts in ethereal currents.
notes: Eldritch Invocations include Mask of Many Faces, One with Shadows, and Visions of Distant Realms. Telepathy within 120 ft, and can cause Madness with spells like Dream or Contact Other Plane.

name: Second Chancellor Henwin Trusk
description: Charming and impeccably dressed, Henwin always smells faintly of rosewater and ink. His smooth voice can cut through chaos and sway even the most stubborn nobles.
notes:
Has Unfailing Inspiration and Universal Speech features
Knows Suggestion, Charm Person, Mass Healing Word, Counterspell, Calm Emotions
Maintains diplomatic relations and is a master of negotiation
Silver tongue can magically enhance persuasion to unnatural degrees

name: Third Chancellor Baeli Mossglen
description: A tiny gnome with frizzy hair, coin-shaped glasses, and gold dust on their sleeves. Often speaks to coins and keeps a diary of "financial prophecies."
notes:
Has Portent feature (2 daily d20 rolls)
Known spells: Divination, Arcane Eye, Detect Thoughts, Clairvoyance, Identify
Acts as the guild’s magical audit and enforcer of magically bound contracts
Believes the flow of gold reflects the will of fate

name: Commander Yselle Valric
description: A tall half-elf with braided red-blonde hair and a warm voice, often found training cadets or aiding the wounded.
notes:
Abilities: Channel Divinity: Champion Challenge, Divine Allegiance, Aura of Courage
Known spells: Command, Zone of Truth, Compelled Duel, Aura of Vitality
Known for her compassionate but firm approach—respected by soldiers and citizens alike

name: Warden-Knight Borund Shieldvein
description: A gruff, barrel-chested dwarf with a scorched beard, holy tattoos, and a thick dwarven accent. Often found blessing weapons in the forge-shrine.
notes:
Features: War Priest, Guided Strike, War God's Blessing
Spells: Spiritual Weapon, Guardian of Faith, Flame Strike, Bless, Divine Favor
Maintains the Crimson Guard’s spiritual edge—believes divine strength flows through steel

name: The Wyrm 'Khor Nelis'
description: With obsidian scales and glowing violet eyes, Khor’s breath fogs the air in unnatural darkness. His hands spark with shadow threads.
notes:
Features: Eyes of the Dark, Strength of the Grave, Hound of Ill Omen
Spells: Darkness, Shadow Blade, Greater Invisibility, Counterspell, Dimension Door
Maintains the faction’s arcane labs and manipulates shadow-based planar tears

name: The Dagger 'Serrik Vale'
description: A soft-footed halfling who always seems to be just behind you. Pale eyes and silent steps. Never blinks.
notes:
Features: Assassinate, Infiltration Expertise, Sneak Attack (6d6)
Can communicate telepathically with others within 30 ft
Special gear allows memory suppression (target forgets they saw him)
Uses poisons, illusion powder, and vanish smoke

name: Shahzada Kareth el-Cahir
description: Draped in flowing desert silks and adorned with golden rings, Kareth’s calm demeanor conceals deep reservoirs of magic. His eyes reflect shimmering dunes.
notes:
Metamagic: Twinned Spell, Subtle Spell, Empowered Spell.
Spellcasting Focus: Sand Crystal Scepter.
Signature Spells: Greater Invisibility, Banishment, Guardian of Faith, and Wall of Light.
Diplomatically inclined but not afraid to wield divine wrath.

name: Prince Samira el-Zahir
notes:
Uses dual scimitars and desert camouflage tactics.
Has trained with Winda gladiators in secret.

name: Vizier Rahim Dossar
notes:
Master of bureaucracy and enchantment charms.
Keeps the palace bureaucracy flowing through mind-bending negotiation.

name: 'Bloodmaw' Veera Thorne
description: Muscled and scarred with glowing red tattoos, Veera speaks rarely—her growl alone often settles disputes.
notes:
Rage-fueled resurrection once per day.
Known to take bites out of her enemies.

name: Arlo Vintheel
description: Covered in soot and grease, Arlo wears goggles and a bandolier of tools and potions. His Steel Defender is shaped like a velociraptor.
notes:
Deploys mechanical scouts and trap drones in the arena.
Trades invention secrets for influence.

name: Counsel Gall Guard
description: Guards that protect the counsel hall and everything within it - event the vault.

name: Arche
description: Leader of the counsel hall. Appointed by the three faction leaders of Rena. This individual has no alliances to any of the factions.
